as_told.title: Letters and former navy officers tell Asberg of objects crashed into the water

plain: Since 2011, many people have written to a Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, by email and even on paper, saying they saw cigar-shaped objects crash into the water and into forests. He tells Michels that some of those who contacted him were former navy officers. He passes on what they told him because he believes there is a UFO on the seafloor, and their stories would back up his find.
